critical_code_review_comments: pnl.py _find_cols(): 'cost' substring match is greedy — a header like 'Cost Price' matches (fine) but so would 'Costing Center'. Acceptable given controlled template.
pnl.py /sku-costs/upload has no auth dependency; other write endpoints in the app typically require admin. Consider adding auth guard for consistency.
pnl.py aggregations pull to_list(20000/300000) — safe for current dataset (~5.8K SKUs) but should be paginated/streamed if data grows.
